title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 58 (Mudge Island)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Mudge Island
58 That portion of M.U. 1-1 in the Strait of Georgia which is contained within the following described boundary: The mean low water mark of Mudge Island. [en. B.C. Reg. 194/99, s. 3.]
